svg.title: Every subgroup can disagree with the total
svg.desc: Blank version of the sketch “Every subgroup can disagree with the total” with all labels removed, for drawing from memory. A whiteboard sketch of the 1973 Berkeley admissions data drawn as six departments, each showing a blue dot for men and a green dot for women with women equal or higher in four of six, arranged along a steep red downward trend line so the aggregate reads men 44.5 percent against women 30.4 percent; three small causal diagrams distinguishing a confounder, a collider and a mediator with what to control for written under each; two scatter plots where a single outlier takes the Pearson correlation from 0.895 to 0.087 while Spearman stays at 0.885; and a bar showing 257 of 4,950 pairs of pure noise variables reaching p below 0.05.
svg.text: Every subgroup can disagree with the total
draw it from memory, then compare
